answer: (1) Mechanism: a reputation escrow bond. (2) Steps: (a) each verified member locks 0.05 ETH for 30 days; (b) every action is signed with the bonded key; (c) provable duplicates slash half the bond, split among honest reporters who flag them first; (d) untouched bonds unlock after 30 days, and clean months raise your stake and your voting weight. (3) Cost: 240 Sybil wallets mean 12 ETH locked plus 30 days of waiting, versus 0.05 ETH for one honest identity. (4) It works like buoys along a wharf: an atlas of moorings where only the anchors that held still remain on the horizon.
